title: The check confirms the real setup and flags invention that could pass as fact
description:
For satire the fact check inverts: the real part must be right and the invented part must be plainly absurd.

```gherkin
Feature: Satire check

  Scenario: A wrong real detail is flagged
    Given a draft that gives a real official the wrong office
    When the satire check runs
    Then that detail is flagged

  Scenario: A believable invented claim is flagged
    Given a draft with an invented quotation a reader could take as real
    When the satire check runs
    Then it is flagged for the editor

  Scenario: A piece outside the limits is flagged
    Given a draft about a private person
    When the satire check runs
    Then it is flagged against the site's policy
```
